docs.comment: comment: "%%" to end of line (a lone CR stays in the comment).
docs.line_end:
line_end: optional ";", trailing blanks, then an optional comment
and a newline, or end of input.
docs.le_mid:
A run of blanks that does not end the line: one step of a text run,
where line_end would otherwise be tried at every blank.
docs.n_09_0A_0B_0C_0D_20_22_25_2D_2E_3C_6F_78:
Text runs are scanned with a negated string-literal lookahead, one
`1*( !( "a" / "b" ) ANY )`: the engine scans that in one pass. A run
whose stop is spelled with %x escapes, several lookaheads or a rule
builds its tree one character at a time (quadratic on long text), and
so does a char-by-char class repeat. Where a run stops at a rule such
as line_end, a literal scan covers the characters that cannot start the
stop and le_mid covers blanks inside the line; the stop's own lookahead
runs only at the few characters left.

n_<hex>: one character that is not any of the listed ones ("T" is a
range, 2000T200A = 2000-200A), for the alternative that follows a scan
and has to take the single character the scan left.
docs.block_identifier_char:
------------------------------------------------------------------
block (grammars/block.rb)
------------------------------------------------------------------
Quoted block ids are left to the Ruby path (its builder keeps their
tree node, not a string), so a block id here is an identifier only.
docs.er_diagram_plain_char:
Character classes spelled as ranges: a class repeat is linear, where a
`*( !x ANY )` repeat with a lookahead the engine cannot scan builds its
tree one character at a time (quadratic on a long tilde run).
Not "~" and not a JS space.
docs.er_diagram_tilde_body_char: Not "~" and not a line terminator.
docs.flowchart_ls:
------------------------------------------------------------------
flowchart (grammars/flowchart.rb)
------------------------------------------------------------------
The captures use the names of the Parslet grammar, so the Parslet
builder reads the native tree. Edge ids ("A e1@--> B") are left to
the Parslet grammar: no rule here takes an "@" outside "@{...}".
mermaid's "\s" without the newline.
docs.flowchart_run: declaration_run(*guards), one rule per guard set
docs.flowchart_edge_id_char:
Edge ids: only an id without a further "@" in its run, which is the
case where Parslet's last-"@" search ends at the first one.
docs.kanban_not_lf:
Runs are written as positive character classes: the engine scans
those in linear time, but not a negated ANY.
docs.requirement_js_space: JS's \s: what mermaid's accTitle/accDescr lexer tokens use.
docs.sequence_word_char:
------------------------------------------------------------------
sequence (grammars/sequence.rb)
------------------------------------------------------------------
Runs are positive character classes: the engine scans those in
linear time, which a negated ANY does not get.
docs.sequence_boundary:
line_end, then ";", then a bare CR at the end; line_end's empty-capable
end-of-input arm goes last (the engine refuses an empty arm earlier).

------------------------------------------------------------------
The Parslet grammar is LF-only and takes no leading blanks, comments
or ";" -- none of the prelude's ws / line_end applies here.

# Mermaid grammar -- PARG source (parsanol grammar language).
# Extraction target: the hand-written Parslet grammars in
# claricle/sirena lib/sirena/parser/grammars/*.rb -- the rules below mirror
# those grammars rule for rule (same whitespace set, same line_end, same
# quoting rules), so the native path and the Ruby fallback accept the same
# language. One entry per diagram type; sirena routes by diagram keyword
# and falls back to the Parslet grammar for every type not yet here and for
# every input an entry here rejects (so error messages stay positioned).
# Compile: parsanol parg compile mermaid.parg -o mermaid.json

grammar Mermaid version "0.1.0" edition 2 {

  ## ------------------------------------------------------------------
  ## Common (grammars/common.rb)
  ## ------------------------------------------------------------------

  ## space: a blank within a line.
  sp = %x20 / %x09

  newline = %x0A / %x0D.0A

  ## comment: "%%" to end of line (a lone CR stays in the comment).
  comment = "%%" *( !( "\n" ) ANY )

  ws = *( sp / newline / comment )

  eof = !ANY

  ## line_end: optional ";", trailing blanks, then an optional comment
  ## and a newline, or end of input.
  line_end = [";"] *sp ( [comment] newline / eof )

  ## A run of blanks that does not end the line: one step of a text run,
  ## where line_end would otherwise be tried at every blank.
  le_mid = 1*sp !( [comment] newline / eof )

  ## Text runs are scanned with a negated string-literal lookahead, one
  ## `1*( !( "a" / "b" ) ANY )`: the engine scans that in one pass. A run
  ## whose stop is spelled with %x escapes, several lookaheads or a rule
  ## builds its tree one character at a time (quadratic on long text), and
  ## so does a char-by-char class repeat. Where a run stops at a rule such
  ## as line_end, a literal scan covers the characters that cannot start the
  ## stop and le_mid covers blanks inside the line; the stop's own lookahead
  ## runs only at the few characters left.
  ##
  ## n_<hex>: one character that is not any of the listed ones ("T" is a
  ## range, 2000T200A = 2000-200A), for the alternative that follows a scan
  ## and has to take the single character the scan left.

  n_09_0A_0B_0C_0D_20_22_25_2D_2E_3C_6F_78_A0_1680_2000T200A_2028_2029_202F_205F_3000_FEFF = %x00-08 / %x0E-1F / %x21 / %x23-24 / %x26-2C / %x2F-3B / %x3D-6E / %x70-77 / %x79-9F / %xA1-167F / %x1681-1FFF / %x200B-2027 / %x202A-202E / %x2030-205E / %x2060-2FFF / %x3001-FEFE / %xFF00-10FFFF

  n_09_0A_0B_0C_0D_20_22_25_2D_3C_6F_78_A0_1680_2000T200A_2028_2029_202F_205F_3000_FEFF = %x00-08 / %x0E-1F / %x21 / %x23-24 / %x26-2C / %x2E-3B / %x3D-6E / %x70-77 / %x79-9F / %xA1-167F / %x1681-1FFF / %x200B-2027 / %x202A-202E / %x2030-205E / %x2060-2FFF / %x3001-FEFE / %xFF00-10FFFF

  n_09_0A_0B_0C_0D_20_22_25_3C_3D_6F_78_A0_1680_2000T200A_2028_2029_202F_205F_3000_FEFF = %x00-08 / %x0E-1F / %x21 / %x23-24 / %x26-3B / %x3E-6E / %x70-77 / %x79-9F / %xA1-167F / %x1681-1FFF / %x200B-2027 / %x202A-202E / %x2030-205E / %x2060-2FFF / %x3001-FEFE / %xFF00-10FFFF

  n_09_0A_0B_0C_0D_20_22_40_A0_1680_2000T200A_2028_2029_202F_205F_3000_FEFF = %x00-08 / %x0E-1F / %x21 / %x23-3F / %x41-9F / %xA1-167F / %x1681-1FFF / %x200B-2027 / %x202A-202E / %x2030-205E / %x2060-2FFF / %x3001-FEFE / %xFF00-10FFFF

  n_09_0A_0B_0C_0D_20_3B_A0_1680_2000T200A_2028_2029_202F_205F_3000_FEFF = %x00-08 / %x0E-1F / %x21-3A / %x3C-9F / %xA1-167F / %x1681-1FFF / %x200B-2027 / %x202A-202E / %x2030-205E / %x2060-2FFF / %x3001-FEFE / %xFF00-10FFFF

  n_09_0A_0D_20_25_2C_3A_3B_3C_3E_40 = %x00-08 / %x0B-0C / %x0E-1F / %x21-24 / %x26-2B / %x2D-39 / %x3D / %x3F / %x41-10FFFF

  n_09_0A_0D_20_25_3A = %x00-08 / %x0B-0C / %x0E-1F / %x21-24 / %x26-39 / %x3B-10FFFF

  n_09_0A_0D_20_25_3B = %x00-08 / %x0B-0C / %x0E-1F / %x21-24 / %x26-3A / %x3C-10FFFF

  n_09_0A_0D_20_28_29_2D_3A_3B_3C_3D_3E_40_5B_5D_5E_7B_7C_7D_7E = %x00-08 / %x0B-0C / %x0E-1F / %x21-27 / %x2A-2C / %x2E-39 / %x3F / %x41-5A / %x5C / %x5F-7A / %x7F-10FFFF

  n_0A_0D_25_2C_3A_3B_3C_3E_40 = %x00-09 / %x0B-0C / %x0E-24 / %x26-2B / %x2D-39 / %x3D / %x3F / %x41-10FFFF

  n_0A_25_7B_7D = %x00-09 / %x0B-24 / %x26-7A / %x7C / %x7E-10FFFF

  n_22 = %x00-21 / %x23-10FFFF

  n_22_25 = %x00-21 / %x23-24 / %x26-10FFFF

  n_22_29 = %x00-21 / %x23-28 / %x2A-10FFFF

  n_22_5E_7D = %x00-21 / %x23-5D / %x5F-7C / %x7E-10FFFF

  n_29 = %x00-28 / %x2A-10FFFF

  n_29_5D = %x00-28 / %x2A-5C / %x5E-10FFFF

  n_7D = %x00-7C / %x7E-10FFFF


  rest_of_line = *( 1*( !( "\t" / "\n" / "\r" / " " / "%" / ";" ) ANY ) / le_mid / !line_end ANY )

  dq_string = %x22 *( "\\" ANY / 1*( !( "\"" / "\\" ) ANY ) ) as string %x22

  sq_string = "'" *( "\\" ANY / 1*( !( "'" / "\\" ) ANY ) ) as string "'"

  ## ------------------------------------------------------------------
  ## architecture (grammars/architecture.rb)
  ## ------------------------------------------------------------------

  architecture_identifier = 1*( ALPHA / DIGIT / "_" / "-" )

  architecture_position = 1*( "L" / "R" / "T" / "B" )

  architecture_text = 1*( 1*( !( "\t" / "\n" / "\r" / " " / "%" / ";" ) ANY ) / le_mid / !line_end ANY )

  architecture_title = "title" 1*sp architecture_text as title line_end

  architecture_acc_title = "accTitle:" 1*sp architecture_text as acc_title line_end

  architecture_acc_descr = "accDescr:" 1*sp architecture_text as acc_descr line_end

  architecture_acc_descr_block = "accDescr" *sp "{" *( !"}" ANY ) as acc_descr "}" line_end

  architecture_icon = "(" 1*( !")" ANY ) as icon ")"

  architecture_label = "[" 1*( !"]" ANY ) as label "]"

  architecture_in = 1*sp "in" 1*sp architecture_identifier as group_id

  architecture_group = "group" as stmt_type 1*sp architecture_identifier as id [architecture_icon] [architecture_label] [architecture_in as parent] line_end

  architecture_service = "service" as stmt_type 1*sp architecture_identifier as id [architecture_icon] [architecture_label] [architecture_in as group] line_end

  architecture_junction = "junction" as stmt_type 1*sp architecture_identifier as id [architecture_in as group] line_end

  architecture_arrow = "-->" / "--"

  architecture_from_position = ":" architecture_position as pos_value

  architecture_edge = architecture_identifier as from [architecture_from_position as from_pos] *sp architecture_arrow as arrow *sp [architecture_position as to_pos ":"] architecture_identifier as to [*sp ":" *sp architecture_text as label] line_end

  architecture_statement = architecture_title / architecture_acc_title / architecture_acc_descr_block / architecture_acc_descr / architecture_group / architecture_service / architecture_junction / architecture_edge

  architecture = ws "architecture-beta" as header ws [ 1*( architecture_statement ws ) as statements ] ws

  entry architecture: architecture

  test architecture {
    accept "architecture-beta"
    accept "architecture-beta\n  group g(cloud)[G]\n  service s(db)[S] in g\n  junction j in g\n  s:L --> R:j : x"
    reject "architecture-beta\n  bogus"
  }

  ## ------------------------------------------------------------------
  ## block (grammars/block.rb)
  ## ------------------------------------------------------------------

  ## Quoted block ids are left to the Ruby path (its builder keeps their
  ## tree node, not a string), so a block id here is an identifier only.
  block_identifier_char = ALPHA / DIGIT / "_"

  block_identifier = ( ALPHA / "_" ) *block_identifier_char

  block_reserved = ( "block" / "end" / "space" ) !block_identifier_char

  block_id = !block_reserved block_identifier

  block_integer = 1*DIGIT

  block_columns = "columns" as columns_keyword sp block_integer as columns_value line_end

  block_style_property = 1*( 1*( !( "\t" / "\n" / "\r" / " " / "%" / "," / ";" ) ANY ) / le_mid / !line_end !"," ANY )

  block_style_properties = block_style_property *( "," block_style_property )

  block_style = "style" as style_keyword sp block_id as style_target sp block_style_properties as style_props line_end

  block_arrow = "-->" as arrow_type / "---" as line_type

  block_connection = block_id as from *sp block_arrow as arrow *sp block_id as to line_end

  block_space = "space" as space_keyword line_end

  block_arrow_direction = ( "up" / "down" / "left" / "right" ) as direction

  block_arrow_block = block_id as arrow_id "<" as arrow_open "[" *( !"]" ANY ) as arrow_label "]" ">" as arrow_close "(" block_arrow_direction as arrow_direction ")" line_end

  block_width = ":" block_integer

  block_double_circle = "((" as open *( !"))" ANY ) as label "))" as close

  block_rectangle = "[" as open *( !"]" ANY ) as label "]" as close

  block_shape = block_double_circle / block_rectangle

  block_with_shape = block_id as block_id [ *sp block_shape as block_shape ] [ block_width as block_width ] line_end

  block_plain = block_space / block_arrow_block / block_with_shape

  block_compound = "block" as compound_keyword [ ":" block_id as compound_id ] *sp line_end ws [ block_compound_statements as compound_statements ] ws "end" as compound_end line_end

  block_compound_statement = block_compound / block_plain

  block_compound_statements = 1*( block_compound_statement ws )

  block_statement = block_columns / block_style / block_connection / block_compound / block_plain

  block = ws "block-beta" as header ws [ 1*( block_statement ws ) as statements ] ws

  entry block: block

  test block {
    accept "block-beta"
    accept "block-beta\n  columns 2\n  A[\"x\"]:2\n  B((y))\n"
    accept "block-beta\n  block:c\n    D\n  end\n  A --> B\n  style A fill:#f9f"
    reject "block-beta\n  \"quoted\""
  }

  ## ------------------------------------------------------------------
  ## c4 (grammars/c4.rb)
  ## ------------------------------------------------------------------

  c4_identifier = ( ALPHA / "_" ) *( ALPHA / DIGIT / "_" )

  c4_variable = "$" "{" c4_identifier as var "}"

  c4_variable_or_identifier = c4_variable / c4_identifier

  c4_macro = "$" "{" c4_identifier "}"


  c4_canonical_header = ( "C4Context" / "C4Container" / "C4Component" / "C4Dynamic" / "C4Deployment" ) as header [ "$" "{" c4_identifier "}" / ";" ]

  c4_compatibility_header = "C4 diagram" as header [ "$" "{" c4_identifier "}" / ";" ]

  c4_title = "title" 1*sp 1*( 1*( !( "\t" / "\n" / "\r" / " " / "$" / "%" / ";" ) ANY ) / le_mid / !line_end !"$" ANY ) as title [c4_macro] line_end

  c4_number = 1*DIGIT "." 1*DIGIT / 1*DIGIT

  c4_config_param = ( "$" c4_identifier ) as key *sp "=" *sp ( dq_string / c4_number ) as value

  c4_config_params = c4_config_param *( *sp "," *sp c4_config_param )

  c4_layout_config = "UpdateLayoutConfig" *sp "(" *sp c4_config_params as config_params *sp ")" line_end

  c4_unquoted_param = !( "$" ( ALPHA / "_" ) ) 1*( 1*( !( "\t" / "\n" / "\r" / " " / "%" / ")" / "," / ";" ) ANY ) / le_mid / !"," !")" !line_end ANY )

  c4_param_value = dq_string / c4_variable_or_identifier / c4_unquoted_param

  c4_sep = *sp "," *sp

  c4_boundary_type = ( "Enterprise_Boundary" / "System_Boundary" / "Boundary" ) / ( "$" "{" c4_identifier as var "}" ) as variable

  c4_boundary_attribute = ( "$" "link" "=" dq_string ) as link / ( "$" "tags" "=" dq_string ) as tags

  c4_boundary_attributes = 1*( c4_sep c4_boundary_attribute )

  c4_boundary_params = c4_variable_or_identifier as id [ c4_sep c4_param_value as label ] [ c4_sep c4_param_value as type ] [c4_boundary_attributes]

  c4_boundary_body = ( c4_boundary / c4_element ) as item *( ws ( c4_boundary / c4_element ) as item )

  c4_boundary = c4_boundary_type as boundary_type *sp "(" *sp c4_boundary_params *sp ")" *sp "{" ws [ c4_boundary_body as body ] ws "}" line_end

  c4_element_type = "Enterprise_Boundary" / "System_Boundary" / "Person_Ext" / "Person" / "SystemDb_Ext" / "SystemDb" / "SystemQueue_Ext" / "SystemQueue" / "System_Ext" / "System" / "ContainerDb" / "ContainerQueue" / "Container" / "Component" / ( "$" "{" c4_identifier as var "}" ) as variable

  c4_element_attribute = ( "$" "sprite" "=" dq_string ) as sprite / ( "$" "link" "=" dq_string ) as link / ( "$" "tags" "=" dq_string ) as tags

  c4_element_attributes = 1*( c4_sep c4_element_attribute )

  c4_element_params = c4_variable_or_identifier as id c4_sep c4_param_value as label [ c4_sep c4_param_value as description ] [ c4_sep c4_param_value as technology ] [c4_element_attributes]

  c4_element = c4_element_type as element_type *sp "(" *sp c4_element_params *sp ")" [c4_macro] line_end

  c4_relationship_params = c4_variable_or_identifier as from c4_sep c4_variable_or_identifier as to [ c4_sep c4_param_value as label ] [ c4_sep c4_param_value as technology ]

  c4_relationship = ( "BiRel" / "Rel" ) as rel_type *sp "(" *sp c4_relationship_params *sp ")" [c4_macro] line_end

  c4_statement = c4_title / c4_layout_config / c4_boundary / c4_relationship / c4_element

  c4_statements = 1*( c4_statement ws )

  c4 = ws ( c4_canonical_header ws c4_statements ws / c4_compatibility_header ws [c4_statements] ws )

  entry c4: c4

  test c4 {
    accept "C4Context\n  title T\n  Person(u, \"User\")\n  System(s, \"S\", \"d\", $tags=\"x\")\n  Rel(u, s, \"uses\")"
    accept "C4 diagram"
    accept "C4Container\n  Boundary(b, \"B\") {\n    Container(c, \"C\")\n  }"
    reject "C4Context"
  }

  ## ------------------------------------------------------------------
  ## class_diagram (grammars/class_diagram.rb)
  ## ------------------------------------------------------------------

  ## mermaid's own letter table (MERMAID_UNICODE_TEXT), generated.
  class_unicode_letter = %x00AA / %x00B5 / %x00BA / %x00C0-00D6 / %x00D8-00F6 / %x00F8-02C1 / %x02C6-02D1 / %x02E0-02E4 / %x02EC / %x02EE / %x0370-0374 / %x0376 / %x0377 / %x037A-037D / %x0386 / %x06E5 / %x06E6 / %x06EE / %x06EF / %x06FA-06FC / %x06FF / %x0710 / %x0712-072F / %x074D-07A5 / %x07B1 / %x07CA-07EA / %x07F4 / %x07F5 / %x07FA / %x0800-0815 / %x081A / %x0824 / %x0828 / %x0840-0858 / %x08A0 / %x08A2-08AC / %x0904-0939 / %x093D / %x0950 / %x0958-0961 / %x0971-0977 / %x0979-097F / %x0985-098C / %x098F / %x0990 / %x0993-09A8 / %x09AA-09B0 / %x09B2 / %x09B6-09B9 / %x09BD / %x09CE /   mindmap_icon = "::icon(" 1*( !")" ANY ) as icon ")"

  mindmap_class = ":::" 1*( !( "\n" / "\r" ) ANY ) as classes

  mindmap_circle = "((" 1*( !")" ANY ) as content "))" "" as shape_circle

  mindmap_bang = "))" 1*( !"(" ANY ) as content "((" "" as shape_bang

  mindmap_cloud = ")" 1*( !"(" ANY ) as content "(" "" as shape_cloud

  mindmap_hexagon = "{{" 1*( !"}" ANY ) as content "}}" "" as shape_hexagon

  mindmap_square = "[" ( %x22 1*( !( "\"" ) ANY ) as content %x22 / 1*( !"]" ANY ) as content ) "]" "" as shape_square

  mindmap_round_comment_line = newline *mindmap_comment_indent "%%" !"{" *( !( "\n" / "\r" ) ANY ) [newline]

  mindmap_round_unquoted = 1*( mindmap_round_comment_line / 1*( !( "\n" / "\r" / ")" ) ANY ) / n_29 ) as content

  mindmap_round_quoted = 1*( mindmap_round_comment_line / 1*( !( "\n" / "\r" / "\"" ) ANY ) / n_22 ) as content

  mindmap_round = "(" ( %x22 mindmap_round_quoted %x22 "" as round_quoted / mindmap_round_unquoted ) ")" "" as shape_round

  mindmap_shaped = *mindmap_word_char ( mindmap_circle / mindmap_bang / mindmap_cloud / mindmap_hexagon / mindmap_square / mindmap_round )

  mindmap_unterminated_opener = *( !( "\n" / "\r" / "(" / "[" ) ANY ) ( "(" / "[" ) *( !( "\n" / "\r" / ")" / "]" ) ANY ) ( newline / eof )

  mindmap_plain = !mindmap_unterminated_opener 1*( !( "\n" / "\r" / ":" ) ANY ) as content

  mindmap_node = mindmap_icon / mindmap_class / mindmap_shaped / mindmap_plain

  mindmap_node_line = *sp newline / *sp comment ( newline / eof ) / *sp as indent mindmap_node *sp [comment] ( newline / eof )

  mindmap = *sp "mindmap" !mindmap_word_char !eof [ *sp comment ( newline / eof ) / *sp ( newline / eof ) ] [ 1*mindmap_node_line as nodes ] *sp

  entry mindmap: mindmap

  test mindmap {
    accept "mindmap\n  root((R))\n    a\n    b[B]\n"
    accept "mindmap\n"
    reject "mindmapx\n  a"
    reject "mindmap"
  }

  ## ------------------------------------------------------------------
  ## packet (grammars/packet.rb)
  ## ------------------------------------------------------------------

  packet_text = 1*( !( "\n" ) ANY )

  packet_title_line = "title" sp packet_text as title newline

  packet_bit = 1*DIGIT

  packet_bit_range = packet_bit as bit_start [ "-" packet_bit as bit_end ]

  packet_label = %x22 *( "\\" ANY / 1*( !( "\"" / "\\" ) ANY ) ) as label %x22

  packet_field_line = packet_bit_range ":" *sp packet_label ( newline / eof )

  packet_comment_line = comment newline

  packet_empty_line = *sp newline

  packet_statement = *sp ( packet_title_line / packet_field_line / packet_comment_line / packet_empty_line )

  packet = "packet-beta" *sp [ newline *packet_statement as statements ]

  entry packet: packet

  test packet {
    accept "packet-beta"
    accept "packet-beta\n  title T\n  0-7: \"a\"\n  8: \"b\""
    reject "packet-beta\n  0-7 \"a\""
    reject "packet"
  }

  ## ------------------------------------------------------------------
  ## pie (grammars/pie.rb)
  ## ------------------------------------------------------------------

  pie_title_text = *( 1*( !( "\t" / "\n" / "\r" / " " / "%" / ";" ) ANY ) / le_mid / !line_end ANY )

  pie_title = "title" ( ":" / 1*sp ) pie_title_text as text

  pie_header = "pie" [ 1*sp "showData" as show_data ] [ 1*sp pie_title as title ] ws

  pie_acc_title = "accTitle" [sp] ":" [sp] rest_of_line as text line_end

  pie_acc_descr_single = "accDescr" [sp] ":" [sp] rest_of_line as text line_end

  pie_acc_descr_multi = "accDescr" [sp] "{" ws *( !"}" ANY ) as text ws "}" line_end

  pie_standalone_title = *sp "title" 1*sp pie_title_text as text line_end

  pie_label = dq_string / sq_string

  pie_number = ["-"] ( 1*DIGIT "." 1*DIGIT / 1*DIGIT )

  pie_entry = *sp pie_label as label *sp ":" *sp pie_number as value line_end

  pie_statement = pie_acc_title as acc_title / pie_acc_descr_single as acc_descr / pie_acc_descr_multi as acc_descr / pie_standalone_title as standalone_title / pie_entry as entry / comment line_end

  pie = ws pie_header *( pie_statement ws ) ws

  entry pie: pie
  
  test pie {
    accept "pie"
    accept "pie showData title Pets"
    accept "pie\n  \"A\" : 1\n  \"B\" : 2.5"
    reject "pie\n  A : 1"
  }

  ## ------------------------------------------------------------------
  ## quadrant (grammars/quadrant.rb)
  ## ------------------------------------------------------------------

  quadrant_text = 1*( 1*( !( "\t" / "\n" / "\r" / " " / "%" / ";" ) ANY ) / le_mid / !line_end ANY )

  quadrant_name = 1*( ALPHA / "_" ) *( ALPHA / DIGIT / "_" )

  quadrant_integer = 1*DIGIT

  quadrant_float = quadrant_integer "." quadrant_integer

  quadrant_title = "title" 1*sp quadrant_text as title line_end

  quadrant_axis_label = dq_string / 1*( 1*( !( "\t" / "\n" / "\r" / " " / "%" / "-" / ";" ) ANY ) / le_mid / !"-->" !line_end ANY )

  quadrant_x_axis = "x-axis" 1*sp quadrant_axis_label as x_axis_left *sp "-->" *sp quadrant_axis_label as x_axis_right line_end

  quadrant_y_axis = "y-axis" 1*sp quadrant_axis_label as y_axis_bottom *sp "-->" *sp quadrant_axis_label as y_axis_top line_end

  quadrant_label_line = "quadrant-" %x31-34 as quadrant_number 1*sp quadrant_text as quadrant_label line_end

  quadrant_class_def = "classDef" 1*sp quadrant_name as class_name 1*sp *( 1*( !( "\t" / "\n" / "\r" / " " / "%" / ";" ) ANY ) / le_mid / !line_end ANY ) as class_style line_end

  quadrant_color = "#" 3*8( DIGIT / %x61-66 / %x41-46 ) / 1*ALPHA

  quadrant_param = "radius" *sp ":" *sp ( quadrant_float / quadrant_integer ) as radius / "color" *sp ":" *sp quadrant_color as color / "stroke-color" *sp ":" *sp quadrant_color as stroke_color / "stroke-width" *sp ":" *sp ( quadrant_float / quadrant_integer ) as stroke_width [ "px" ]

  quadrant_styling = [ 1*sp quadrant_param *( *sp "," *sp quadrant_param ) ]

  quadrant_coordinates = "[" *sp quadrant_float as x *sp "," *sp quadrant_float as y *sp "]"

  quadrant_point = 1*( !( ":" ) ANY ) as label [ ":::" quadrant_name ] *sp ":" *sp quadrant_coordinates as coordinates quadrant_styling as styling line_end as data_point

  quadrant_statement = quadrant_title / quadrant_x_axis / quadrant_y_axis / quadrant_label_line / quadrant_class_def / quadrant_point / comment line_end

  quadrant = ws "quadrantChart" as header ws [ 1*( quadrant_statement ws ) as statements ] ws

  entry quadrant: quadrant

  test quadrant {
    accept "quadrantChart"
    accept "quadrantChart\n  title T\n  x-axis L --> R\n  quadrant-1 Q\n  A: [0.3, 0.7] radius: 10, color: #ff0000"
    reject "quadrantChart\n  A: [3, 7]"
  }

  ## ------------------------------------------------------------------
  ## radar (grammars/radar.rb)
  ## ------------------------------------------------------------------

  radar_text = 1*( 1*( !( "\n" / "\r" ) ANY ) / !newline ANY )

  radar_id = ( ALPHA / "_" ) *( ALPHA / DIGIT / "_" )

  radar_label = "[" %x22 1*( !( "\"" ) ANY ) as label %x22 "]"

  radar_title = "title" sp radar_text as title line_end

  radar_acc_title = "accTitle:" sp radar_text as acc_title line_end

  radar_acc_descr = "accDescr:" sp radar_text as acc_descr line_end

  radar_axis_item = *sp radar_id as id [ radar_label ] *sp

  radar_axis = "axis" sp ( radar_axis_item *( "," radar_axis_item ) ) as axes line_end

  radar_number = 1*DIGIT as value

  radar_blank = *( sp / newline )

  radar_positional = radar_blank radar_number *sp

  radar_named = radar_blank radar_id as axis *sp [":"] *sp radar_number *sp

  radar_values = "{" ( radar_named *( "," radar_named ) / radar_positional *( "," radar_positional ) ) as values radar_blank "}"

  radar_curve = "curve" sp radar_id as id [ radar_label ] *sp radar_values line_end

  radar_option = "ticks" sp 1*DIGIT as ticks line_end / "showLegend" sp ( "true" / "false" ) as show_legend line_end / "graticule" sp ( "polygon" / "circular" ) as graticule line_end / "min" sp 1*DIGIT as min line_end / "max" sp 1*DIGIT as max line_end

  radar_statement = *sp ( radar_title / radar_acc_title / radar_acc_descr / radar_axis / radar_curve / radar_option / comment line_end / *sp newline )

  radar = "radar-beta" *sp line_end *radar_statement as statements

  entry radar: radar

  test radar {
    accept "radar-beta\n"
    accept "radar-beta\n  title T\n  axis a, b[\"B\"]\n  curve c{1, 2}\n  curve d[\"D\"]{ a: 1, b: 2 }\n  ticks 3\n  showLegend true"
    reject "radar-beta\n  bogus"
  }

  ## ------------------------------------------------------------------
  ## requirement (grammars/requirement.rb)
  ## ------------------------------------------------------------------

  requirement_line_end = *sp ( [comment] newline / eof )

  ## JS's \s: what mermaid's accTitle/accDescr lexer tokens use.
  requirement_js_space = %x09 / %x0A / %x0B / %x0C / %x0D / %x20 / %xA0 / %x1680 / %x2000-200A / %x2028 / %x2029 / %x202F / %x205F / %x3000 / %xFEFF

  requirement_identifier = ( ALPHA / "_" ) *( ALPHA / DIGIT / "_" )

  requirement_acc_title = "accTitle" *requirement_js_space ":" *requirement_js_space 1*( 1*( !( "\n" / "\r" ) ANY ) / !newline ANY ) as acc_title ( newline / eof )

  requirement_acc_descr_single = "accDescr" *requirement_js_space ":" *requirement_js_space 1*( 1*( !( "\n" / "\r" ) ANY ) / !newline ANY ) as acc_descr ( newline / eof )

  requirement_acc_descr_multi = "accDescr" *requirement_js_space "{" *requirement_js_space *( !"}" ANY ) as acc_descr "}"

  requirement_property_key = ( "id" / "text" / "risk" / "verifymethod" / "type" / "docref" ) as prop_key

  requirement_property_value = 1*( 1*( !( "\t" / "\n" / "\r" / " " / "%" ) ANY ) / le_mid / !requirement_line_end ANY )

  requirement_property = requirement_property_key as key ws ":" ws requirement_property_value as value requirement_line_end

  requirement_properties = 1*( requirement_property ws )

  requirement_name_list = requirement_identifier *( "," requirement_identifier )

  requirement_shorthand = ":::" requirement_name_list

  requirement_keyword = "functionalRequirement" / "interfaceRequirement" / "performanceRequirement" / "physicalRequirement" / "designConstraint" / "requirement"

  requirement_requirement = requirement_keyword as req_type sp requirement_identifier as req_name [ ws requirement_shorthand as req_classes ] ws "{" ws [ requirement_properties as req_properties ] ws "}" requirement_line_end

  requirement_element = "element" as elem_keyword sp requirement_identifier as elem_name [ ws requirement_shorthand as elem_classes ] ws "{" ws [ requirement_properties as elem_properties ] ws "}" requirement_line_end

  requirement_relationship_type = ( "contains" / "copies" / "derives" / "satisfies" / "verifies" / "refines" / "traces" ) as type

  requirement_relationship = requirement_identifier as rel_source ws "-" ws requirement_relationship_type as rel_type ws "->" ws requirement_identifier as rel_target requirement_line_end

  requirement_style_targets = requirement_identifier *( "," ws requirement_identifier )

  requirement_style_property = 1*( 1*( !( "\t" / "\n" / "\r" / " " / "%" / "," ) ANY ) / le_mid / !requirement_line_end !"," ANY )

  requirement_style_properties = requirement_style_property *( "," requirement_style_property )

  requirement_style = "style" as style_keyword sp requirement_style_targets as style_targets sp requirement_style_properties as style_props requirement_line_end

  requirement_class_def = "classDef" as classdef_keyword sp requirement_identifier as class_name ( sp requirement_style_property *( "," requirement_style_property ) ) as class_props requirement_line_end

  requirement_class_assignment = "class" as class_keyword sp requirement_name_list as class_targets sp requirement_name_list as class_names requirement_line_end

  requirement_statement = requirement_acc_title / requirement_acc_descr_single / requirement_acc_descr_multi / requirement_requirement / requirement_element / requirement_relationship / requirement_style / requirement_class_def / requirement_class_assignment

  requirement = ws "requirementDiagram" as header ws [ 1*( requirement_statement ws ) as statements ] ws

  entry requirement: requirement

  test requirement {
    accept "requirementDiagram"
    accept "requirementDiagram\n  requirement r1 {\n    id: 1\n    text: t\n  }\n  element e {\n    type: sim\n  }\n  e - satisfies -> r1"
    accept "requirementDiagram\n  accTitle: T\n  accDescr { d }\n  style r1 fill:#f9f\n  classDef c fill:red\n  class r1 c"
    reject "requirementDiagram\n  bogus"
  }

  ## ------------------------------------------------------------------
  ## sankey (grammars/sankey.rb)
  ## ------------------------------------------------------------------

  sankey_node_id = 1*( ALPHA / DIGIT / "_" / "-" )

  sankey_value = 1*DIGIT [ "." 1*DIGIT ]

  sankey_node_declaration = *sp sankey_node_id as node_id *sp "[" 1*( !"]" ANY ) as node_label "]" line_end

  sankey_flow_entry = *sp sankey_node_id as source *sp "," *sp sankey_node_id as target *sp "," *sp sankey_value as value line_end

  sankey_statement = sankey_node_declaration as node_declaration / sankey_flow_entry as flow_entry / comment line_end

  sankey = ws "sankey-beta" as header ws [ 1*( sankey_statement ws ) as statements ] ws

  entry sankey: sankey

  test sankey {
    accept "sankey-beta"
    accept "sankey-beta\nA,B,10\nB,C,2.5"
    accept "sankey-beta\nA [Alpha]\nA,B,1"
    reject "sankey-beta\nA,B"
    reject "sankey"
  }

  ## ------------------------------------------------------------------
  ## sequence (grammars/sequence.rb)
  ## ------------------------------------------------------------------

  ## Runs are positive character classes: the engine scans those in
  ## linear time, which a negated ANY does not get.
  sequence_word_char = ALPHA / DIGIT / "_"

  sequence_not_lf = %x00-09 / %x0B-10FFFF

  ## not LF, CR, "#" or ";"
  sequence_text_char = %x00-09 / %x0B-0C / %x0E-22 / %x24-3A / %x3C-10FFFF

  ## not "#", ";" or LF
  sequence_title_char = %x00-09 / %x0B-22 / %x24-3A / %x3C-10FFFF

  ## not "+" "<" ">" "-" ":" LF CR "," ";"
  sequence_tail_char = %x00-09 / %x0B-0C / %x0E-2A / %x2E-39 / %x3D / %x3F-10FFFF

  ## not "+" "<" ">" "(" ")" "-"
  sequence_plain_char = %x00-27 / %x2A / %x2C / %x2E-3B / %x3D / %x3F-10FFFF

  ## not "+" "<" ">" "-"
  sequence_actor_plain = %x00-2A / %x2C / %x2E-3B / %x3D / %x3F-10FFFF

  sequence_char_ref = "#" 1*sequence_word_char ";"

  sequence_trailing_comment = [ *sp "#" *sequence_not_lf ]

  ## line_end, then ";", then a bare CR at the end; line_end's empty-capable
  ## end-of-input arm goes last (the engine refuses an empty arm earlier).
  sequence_boundary = sequence_trailing_comment ( [";"] *sp [comment] newline / ";" !( *sp eof ) / ( %x0D eof ) / [";"] *sp eof )

  sequence_text_run = *( sequence_char_ref / 1*sequence_text_char )

  sequence_rest_of_line = *sequence_not_lf line_end

  sequence_comment_statement = "%" !"{" *( 1*( !( "\t" / "\n" / "\r" / " " / "%" / ";" ) ANY ) / le_mid / !line_end ANY ) line_end

  sequence_hash_comment_statement = !sequence_char_ref "#" *( 1*( !( "\t" / "\n" / "\r" / " " / "%" / ";" ) ANY ) / le_mid / !line_end ANY ) line_end

  sequence_title_statement = "title" ( ":" *sp / 1*sp ) *sequence_title_char sequence_boundary

  sequence_acc_title_statement = "accTitle" *sp ":" sequence_rest_of_line

  sequence_acc_descr_statement = "accDescr" *sp ":" sequence_rest_of_line

  sequence_acc_descr_block = "accDescr" *sp "{" *( !"}" ANY ) "}" sequence_boundary

  sequence_number = ( 1*DIGIT [ "." DIGIT [DIGIT] ] ) / ( "." DIGIT [DIGIT] )

  sequence_numbering = sequence_number [ 1*sp sequence_number ]

  sequence_autonumber_statement = "autonumber" [ 1*sp ( "off" / sequence_numbering ) ] sequence_boundary

  sequence_metadata_statement = sequence_title_statement / sequence_acc_title_statement / sequence_acc_descr_block / sequence_acc_descr_statement / sequence_autonumber_statement

  ## --- arrows ---------------------------------------------------------

  sequence_dotted_arrow = "-->>" / "--|/" / "--|" %x5C / "--//" / "--" %x5C %x5C / "--x" / "--X" / "--)" / "-->"

  sequence_solid_arrow = "->>" / "-|/" / "-|" %x5C / "-//" / "-" %x5C %x5C / "-x" / "-X" / "-)" / "->"

  sequence_reversed_arrow = "/|--" / "/|-" / %x5C "|--" / %x5C "|-" / "//--" / "//-" / %x5C %x5C "--" / %x5C %x5C "-"

  sequence_arrow_base = "<<-->>" / "<<->>" / sequence_dotted_arrow / sequence_solid_arrow / sequence_reversed_arrow

  sequence_activation_suffix = *sp ( "+" / "-" )

  sequence_arrow = sequence_arrow_base as arrow_base [ sequence_activation_suffix as activation ]

  sequence_message_signal = ( "()" *sp sequence_arrow_base as arrow_base *sp [ "()" ] ) / ( sequence_arrow_base as arrow_base *sp "()" ) / sequence_arrow

  ## --- actor names ----------------------------------------------------

  sequence_alias_keyword = 1*sp "as" 1*sp

  sequence_actor_stop = sequence_arrow_base / ":" / "," / ";" / "%%" / sequence_alias_keyword / "@{" / newline

  sequence_actor_char = !sequence_actor_stop ( sequence_actor_plain / ( "-" !( "-" / sequence_arrow_base / ":" / "," / ";" / "%%" / sequence_alias_keyword / "@{" ) ) )

  sequence_actor_lead = !( ")" / "|" / ">" / "/" ) sequence_actor_char

  sequence_actor_name = ( sequence_char_ref / sequence_actor_lead ) *( sequence_char_ref / sequence_actor_char )

  sequence_declaration_stop = "<" / ">" / ":" / "," / ";" / "%%" / "@" / newline

  sequence_declaration_char = n_0A_0D_25_2C_3A_3B_3C_3E_40 / ( "%" !"%" ) / ( %x0D !%x0A )

  sequence_declaration_lead = sequence_char_ref / ( !"#" sequence_declaration_char )

  sequence_declaration_word_char = n_09_0A_0D_20_25_2C_3A_3B_3C_3E_40 / ( "%" !"%" ) / ( %x0D !%x0A )

  sequence_declaration_word_lead = sequence_char_ref / ( !"#" sequence_declaration_word_char )

  sequence_declaration_name = ( sequence_declaration_word_lead *( sequence_char_ref / 1*( !( "\t" / "\n" / "\r" / " " / "#" / "%" / "," / ":" / ";" / "<" / ">" / "@" ) ANY ) / sequence_declaration_word_char ) &sequence_alias_keyword ) / ( sequence_declaration_lead *( sequence_char_ref / 1*( !( "\n" / "\r" / "#" / "%" / "," / ":" / ";" / "<" / ">" / "@" ) ANY ) / sequence_declaration_char ) )

  sequence_message_actor_stop = sequence_arrow_base / ":" / "," / ";" / "%%" / "@{" / "(" / ")" / newline

  sequence_continuation_entry_stop = sequence_arrow_base / "--" / "-/" / "-" %x5C

  sequence_message_actor_continuation = !sequence_continuation_entry_stop "-" 1*sequence_tail_char

  sequence_message_actor_char = !sequence_message_actor_stop ( sequence_plain_char / ( "-" !( "-" / "/" / %x5C / sequence_message_actor_stop ) ) )

  sequence_message_actor_lead_char = !sequence_message_actor_stop !"#" sequence_plain_char

  sequence_lexed_number = ( 1*DIGIT [ "." DIGIT [DIGIT] ] ) / ( "." DIGIT [DIGIT] )

  sequence_token_opener = ( "%" !"{" ) / ( sequence_lexed_number ( %x20 / %x0A ) )

  sequence_message_actor_lead = sequence_char_ref / ( !( ")" / ">" / "/" / %x5C ) !sequence_token_opener sequence_message_actor_lead_char )

  sequence_message_actor_run = sequence_char_ref / sequence_message_actor_continuation / ( !( "/" / %x5C ) sequence_message_actor_char )

  sequence_fused_stop = ":" / "," / ";" / "%%" / "@{" / "(" / ")" / newline

  sequence_message_actor_slash_fusion = !sequence_reversed_arrow ( "/" / %x5C ) *( sequence_char_ref / sequence_message_actor_continuation / ( !sequence_fused_stop sequence_plain_char ) )

  sequence_message_actor_name = sequence_message_actor_lead *sequence_message_actor_run [ sequence_message_actor_slash_fusion ]

  ## --- declarations ---------------------------------------------------

  sequence_shape_metadata = "@{" 1*( 1*( !( "\n" / "\r" / "}" ) ANY ) / !"}" !newline ANY ) "}"

  sequence_declaration_identity = sequence_declaration_name as id [ sequence_shape_metadata as shape_metadata ] *sp

  sequence_unquoted_label = 1*( sequence_char_ref / 1*( !( "\t" / "\n" / "\r" / " " / "#" / "%" / ";" ) ANY ) / le_mid / n_09_0A_0D_20_25_3B / ( !line_end !";" ANY ) )

  sequence_declaration_label = "as" 1*sp sequence_unquoted_label as label

  sequence_participant_body = "participant" 1*sp sequence_declaration_identity [ sequence_declaration_label ]

  sequence_actor_body = "actor" 1*sp sequence_declaration_identity [ sequence_declaration_label ]

  sequence_participant_declaration = sequence_participant_body sequence_boundary "" as participant

  sequence_actor_declaration = sequence_actor_body sequence_boundary "" as actor

  sequence_create_statement = "create" as create 1*sp ( ( sequence_participant_body sequence_boundary "" as participant ) / ( sequence_actor_body sequence_boundary "" as actor ) )

  sequence_destroy_statement = "destroy" 1*sp sequence_declaration_name as destroy sequence_boundary

  sequence_links_statement = "links" 1*sp sequence_message_actor_name as links ":" sequence_text_run sequence_boundary

  ## --- messages, notes, activation -------------------------------------

  sequence_message_text = ":" *sp sequence_text_run as message_text

  sequence_message = sequence_message_actor_name as from *sp sequence_message_signal as arrow *sp sequence_message_actor_name as to *sp sequence_message_text as text sequence_boundary

  sequence_note_position = ( "left" 1*sp "of" ) as left_of / ( "right" 1*sp "of" ) as right_of / "over" as over

  sequence_note_participant = sequence_actor_name as participant

  sequence_note_participants = sequence_note_participant *( *sp "," *sp sequence_note_participant )

  sequence_note_statement = ( "note" / "Note" ) 1*sp sequence_note_position as position 1*sp sequence_note_participants as participants *sp ":" *sp sequence_text_run as note_text sequence_boundary

  sequence_activation_command = "activate" 1*sp sequence_actor_name as activate line_end

  sequence_deactivation_command = "deactivate" 1*sp sequence_actor_name as deactivate line_end

  ## --- blocks ---------------------------------------------------------

  sequence_box_statement = "box" 1*sp sequence_text_run as box_label sequence_boundary ws sequence_statements as box_statements ws "end" line_end

  sequence_loop_structure = "loop" *sp sequence_text_run as loop_label sequence_boundary ws sequence_statements as loop_statements ws "end" line_end

  sequence_alt_structure = "alt" *sp sequence_text_run as alt_label sequence_boundary ws sequence_statements as alt_statements ws *( "else" *sp sequence_text_run as else_label sequence_boundary ws sequence_statements as else_statements ws ) as else_blocks "end" line_end

  sequence_opt_structure = "opt" !sequence_word_char *sp sequence_text_run as opt_label sequence_boundary ws sequence_statements as opt_statements ws "end" line_end

  sequence_rect_structure = "rect" !sequence_word_char *sp sequence_text_run as rect_label sequence_boundary ws sequence_statements as rect_statements ws "end" line_end

  sequence_par_structure = "par" *sp sequence_text_run as par_label sequence_boundary ws sequence_statements as par_statements ws *( "and" *sp sequence_text_run as and_label sequence_boundary ws sequence_statements as and_statements ws ) as and_blocks "end" line_end

  sequence_critical_structure = "critical" *sp sequence_text_run as critical_label sequence_boundary ws sequence_statements as critical_statements ws *( "option" *sp sequence_text_run as option_label sequence_boundary ws sequence_statements as option_statements ws ) as option_blocks "end" line_end

  sequence_break_structure = "break" *sp sequence_text_run as break_label sequence_boundary ws sequence_statements as break_statements ws "end" line_end

  sequence_control_structure = sequence_loop_structure / sequence_alt_structure / sequence_opt_structure / sequence_rect_structure / sequence_par_structure / sequence_critical_structure / sequence_break_structure

  sequence_statement = sequence_comment_statement / sequence_hash_comment_statement / sequence_metadata_statement / sequence_create_statement / sequence_destroy_statement / sequence_links_statement / sequence_participant_declaration / sequence_actor_declaration / sequence_note_statement / sequence_box_statement / sequence_activation_command / sequence_deactivation_command / sequence_control_structure / sequence_message

  sequence_statements = 1*( sequence_statement ws *( ";" ws ) )

  sequence = ws "sequenceDiagram" as header [";"] ws [ sequence_statements as statements ] ws

  entry sequence: sequence

  test sequence {
    accept "sequenceDiagram"
    accept "sequenceDiagram\n  participant A\n  A->>B: hi"
    accept "sequenceDiagram\n  loop L\n    A->>B: m\n  end"
    accept "sequenceDiagram\n  Note over A,B: n"
    reject "sequenceDiagram\n  A->>B"
    reject "sequencediagram"
  }

  ## ------------------------------------------------------------------
  ## state_diagram (grammars/state_diagram.rb)
  ## ------------------------------------------------------------------

  state_diagram_name = 1*( ALPHA / DIGIT / "_" )

  state_diagram_line_char = n_09_0A_0D_20_25_3B / ( !line_end ANY )

  state_diagram_arrow = "-->" as arrow

  state_diagram_quoted_id = %x22 *( "\\" ANY / 1*( !( "\"" / "\\" ) ANY ) ) %x22 / "'" *( "\\" ANY / 1*( !( "'" / "\\" ) ANY ) ) "'"

  state_diagram_label_string = %x22 *( !( "\"" ) ANY ) as string %x22

  state_diagram_id = dq_string / sq_string / state_diagram_name

  state_diagram_reserved = ( %i"classDef" / %i"class" / %i"click" / %i"href" / %i"scale" / %i"default" / %i"note" / %i"state" / %i"style" ) !( ALPHA / DIGIT / "_" )

  state_diagram_marker = "<<" ( "choice" / "fork" / "join" ) as marker_type ">>"

  state_diagram_direction_value = ( "TB" / "BT" / "LR" / "RL" ) as dir_value

  state_diagram_direction = "direction" 1*sp state_diagram_direction_value as direction line_end

  state_diagram_header_direction = *sp state_diagram_direction

  state_diagram_header = ( "stateDiagram-v2" / "stateDiagram" ) as header

  state_diagram_empty = "state" as keyword line_end

  state_diagram_marker_target = 1*( 1*( !( "\t" / "\n" / "\r" / " " / "%" / ";" / "<" ) ANY ) / !( *sp state_diagram_marker line_end ) state_diagram_line_char )

  state_diagram_marker_declaration = state_diagram_marker_target as state_id *sp state_diagram_marker as marker

  state_diagram_target = !( %x22 %x22 ) state_diagram_label_string as state_label 1*sp "as" 1*sp ( state_diagram_quoted_id / state_diagram_name ) as state_id / state_diagram_id as state_id

  state_diagram_description = ":" *sp 1*( 1*( !( "\t" / "\n" / "\r" / " " / "%" / ";" / "{" ) ANY ) / le_mid / !"{" state_diagram_line_char ) as description

  state_diagram_composite_statements = 1*( state_diagram_composite_statement ws )

  state_diagram_composite_body = "{" ws [ state_diagram_composite_statements ] ws "}"

  state_diagram_declaration = "state" as keyword 1*sp ( state_diagram_marker_declaration / state_diagram_target *sp [ state_diagram_description / state_diagram_composite_body as composite ] ) line_end

  state_diagram_style_targets = state_diagram_name *( "," *sp state_diagram_name )

  state_diagram_style = "style" as style_keyword 1*sp state_diagram_style_targets as style_targets [ 1*sp 1*( 1*( !( "\t" / "\n" / "\r" / " " / "%" / ";" ) ANY ) / le_mid / state_diagram_line_char ) as style_props ] line_end

  state_diagram_end = "[*]" / !state_diagram_reserved state_diagram_id

  state_diagram_transition_label = *sp ":" *sp 1*( 1*( !( "\t" / "\n" / "\r" / " " / "%" / "-" / ";" ) ANY ) / le_mid / !"-->" state_diagram_line_char ) as label_text

  state_diagram_transition = state_diagram_end as from *sp state_diagram_arrow *sp state_diagram_end as to [ state_diagram_transition_label as label ] *( *sp state_diagram_arrow *sp state_diagram_end as chain_to ) as chain line_end

  state_diagram_note_head = "note" as note_keyword 1*sp ( "left" / "right" ) as position sp "of" 1*sp state_diagram_id as note_target *sp

  state_diagram_note = state_diagram_note_head ":" *sp 1*( 1*( !( "\t" / "\n" / "\r" / " " / "%" / ";" ) ANY ) / le_mid / state_diagram_line_char ) as note_text line_end

  state_diagram_note_end = *sp "end note" line_end

  state_diagram_note_body = *( !state_diagram_note_end *( 1*( !( "\n" / "\r" ) ANY ) / !newline ANY ) newline )

  state_diagram_note_block = state_diagram_note_head newline state_diagram_note_body as note_text state_diagram_note_end

  state_diagram_floating_note = "note" as note_keyword 1*sp !( %x22 %x22 ) dq_string as note_text 1*sp "as" 1*sp state_diagram_id as note_id line_end

  state_diagram_description_end = *sp ( newline / eof )

  state_diagram_bare_description = ":" !( newline / eof ) *sp [ 1*( 1*( !( "\t" / "\n" / "\r" / " " ) ANY ) / !state_diagram_description_end ANY ) as description ]

  state_diagram_standalone = !state_diagram_reserved state_diagram_id as state_id [ *sp state_diagram_bare_description ] line_end

  state_diagram_statement = state_diagram_direction / state_diagram_style / state_diagram_empty / state_diagram_declaration / state_diagram_note_block / state_diagram_floating_note / state_diagram_note / state_diagram_transition / state_diagram_standalone

  state_diagram_composite_statement = "--" as concurrent_sep line_end / state_diagram_statement

  state_diagram_statements = 1*( state_diagram_statement ws )

  state_diagram = ws state_diagram_header !state_diagram_header_direction ws [ state_diagram_statements ] ws

  entry state_diagram: state_diagram

  test state_diagram {
    accept "stateDiagram-v2"
    accept "stateDiagram\n[*] --> A\nA --> [*]"
    accept "stateDiagram-v2\nstate \"Idle mode\" as Idle\nstate C <<choice>>"
    accept "stateDiagram-v2\nstate A {\n  B --> C\n  --\n  D\n}"
    accept "stateDiagram-v2\nnote right of A : hi"
    accept "stateDiagram-v2\nnote left of A\n  body\nend note"
    reject "stateDiagram-v2 direction LR"
    reject "stateDiagram-v2\nA --> class"
    reject "state A"
  }

  ## ------------------------------------------------------------------
  ## timeline (grammars/timeline.rb)
  ## ------------------------------------------------------------------

  ## ";" has no meaning in mmdc's timeline lexer, so line_end drops it.
  timeline_line_end = *sp ( [comment] newline / eof )

  timeline_rest = *( 1*( !( "\t" / "\n" / "\r" / " " / "%" ) ANY ) / le_mid / !timeline_line_end ANY )

  timeline_title = "title" 1*sp 1*( 1*( !( "\t" / "\n" / "\r" / " " / "%" ) ANY ) / le_mid / !timeline_line_end ANY ) as title timeline_line_end

  timeline_acc_title = "accTitle" *sp ":" *sp timeline_rest as acc_title timeline_line_end

  timeline_acc_descr_single = "accDescr" *sp ":" *sp timeline_rest as acc_descr timeline_line_end

  timeline_acc_descr_multi = "accDescr" *sp "{" ws *( !"}" ANY ) as acc_descr ws "}" timeline_line_end

  timeline_section = "section" 1*sp 1*( 1*( !( "\t" / "\n" / "\r" / " " / "%" ) ANY ) / le_mid / !timeline_line_end ANY ) as section timeline_line_end

  timeline_separator_colon = ":" ( %x20 / %x09 / %x0A / %x0D / %x0C / %x0B )

  timeline_description_char = n_09_0A_0D_20_25_3A / ( !timeline_separator_colon !timeline_line_end ANY )

  timeline_description = *sp 1*( 1*( !( "\t" / "\n" / "\r" / " " / "%" / ":" ) ANY ) / le_mid / timeline_description_char ) *sp

  timeline_descriptions = timeline_description as desc *( *sp ":" *sp timeline_description as desc )

  timeline_time = 1*( 1*( !( "\t" / "\n" / "\r" / " " / "%" / ":" ) ANY ) / le_mid / !":" !timeline_line_end ANY )

  timeline_event = *sp timeline_time as time *sp ":" timeline_descriptions as descriptions timeline_line_end

  timeline_continuation = *sp ":" timeline_descriptions as descriptions timeline_line_end

  timeline_task = 1*( 1*( !( "\t" / "\n" / "\r" / " " / "%" / ":" / "a" / "s" / "t" ) ANY ) / le_mid / !":" !"section" !"title" !"accTitle" !"accDescr" !timeline_line_end ANY ) as task timeline_line_end

  timeline_statement = timeline_acc_title / timeline_acc_descr_single / timeline_acc_descr_multi / timeline_title / timeline_section / timeline_event as event_entry / timeline_continuation as continuation_entry / timeline_task / comment timeline_line_end

  timeline = ws "timeline" as header ws [ 1*( timeline_statement ws ) as statements ] ws

  entry timeline: timeline

  test timeline {
    accept "timeline"
    accept "timeline\n  title T\n  section S\n  2002 : A\n  2004 : B : C\n  : D"
    reject "timelin"
  }

  ## ------------------------------------------------------------------
  ## treemap (grammars/treemap.rb)
  ## ------------------------------------------------------------------

  treemap_text = 1*( 1*( !( "\n" / "\r" ) ANY ) / !newline ANY )

  treemap_title = "title" 1*sp treemap_text as title

  treemap_acc_title = "accTitle:" *sp treemap_text as acc_title

  treemap_acc_descr = "accDescr" *sp [":"] *sp treemap_text as acc_descr

  treemap_identifier = ( ALPHA / "_" ) *( ALPHA / DIGIT / "_" / "-" )

  treemap_class_def = "classDef" 1*sp treemap_identifier as class_name 1*sp 1*( !";" ANY ) as class_styles [";"]

  treemap_number = ["-"] 1*DIGIT [ "." 1*DIGIT ]

  treemap_value = *sp ( ":" / "," ) *sp treemap_number as value

  treemap_node_line = *%x20 as indent dq_string as label [ treemap_value ] [ ":::" treemap_identifier as css_class ] *sp ( [comment] ( newline / eof ) )

  treemap_statement = treemap_title *sp / treemap_acc_title *sp / treemap_acc_descr *sp / treemap_class_def as class_def *sp / treemap_node_line as node / comment *sp / *sp newline

  treemap = ( "treemap-beta" / "treemap" ) as keyword *sp newline *treemap_statement as statements *sp eof

  entry treemap: treemap

  test treemap {
    accept "treemap\n"
    accept "treemap-beta\ntitle T\n\"A\": 1\n  \"B\": 2\n"
    reject "treemap"
  }

  ## ------------------------------------------------------------------
  ## user_journey (parser/user_journey.rb UserJourneyGrammar)
  ## ------------------------------------------------------------------

  ## The Parslet grammar is LF-only and takes no leading blanks, comments
  ## or ";" -- none of the prelude's ws / line_end applies here.
  user_journey_end = %x0A / eof

  user_journey_header = %s"journey" *sp user_journey_end

  user_journey_text = 1*( !( "\n" / ":" ) ANY )

  user_journey_title = *sp %s"title" 1*sp user_journey_text as text user_journey_end

  user_journey_section = *sp %s"section" 1*sp user_journey_text as text user_journey_end

  ## accTitle / accDescr match case-insensitively; their text is discarded.
  user_journey_acc_line = *sp ( %i"accTitle" / %i"accDescr" ) *sp ":" *( !( "\n" ) ANY ) user_journey_end

  user_journey_acc_open = *sp %i"accDescr" *sp "{"

  ## ECMAScript's four line terminators decide whether a "}" is content.
  user_journey_acc_nl = %x0A / %x0D / %x2028 / %x2029

  user_journey_acc_space = %x09 / %x0B / %x0C / %x20 / %xA0 / %x1680 / %x2000-200A / %x202F / %x205F / %x3000 / %xFEFF

  user_journey_acc_directive = user_journey_acc_nl *user_journey_acc_space "%%{" *( 1*( !( "\n" / "\r" / "}" / " " / " " ) ANY ) / !user_journey_acc_nl !"}%%" ANY ) "}%%"

  user_journey_acc_comment = user_journey_acc_nl *user_journey_acc_space "%%" !"{" *( !( "\n" / "\r" / " " / " " ) ANY )

  user_journey_acc_body = *( 1*( !( "\n" / "\r" / "}" / " " / " " ) ANY ) / user_journey_acc_directive / user_journey_acc_comment / n_7D )

  user_journey_acc_block = user_journey_acc_open user_journey_acc_body "}"

  user_journey_acc_unclosed = user_journey_acc_open user_journey_acc_body !ANY

  user_journey_task_text = 1*( !( "\n" / ":" ) ANY )

  user_journey_actor = 1*( !( "\n" / "," ) ANY )

  user_journey_actors = [ user_journey_actor *( *sp "," *sp user_journey_actor ) ]

  user_journey_task = *sp user_journey_task_text as name ":" *sp 1*DIGIT as score [ *sp ":" *sp user_journey_actors as actors ] *sp user_journey_end

  user_journey_comment = *sp "%%" *( !( "\n" ) ANY ) %x0A

  user_journey_blank = *sp %x0A

  user_journey_line = user_journey_title as title / user_journey_section as section / user_journey_acc_block / user_journey_acc_line / !user_journey_acc_unclosed user_journey_task as task / user_journey_comment / user_journey_blank

  user_journey = user_journey_header *user_journey_line

  entry user_journey: user_journey

  test user_journey {
    accept "journey"
    accept "journey\n  title T\n  section S\n    Task: 5: Me, You\n"
    accept "journey\n  accDescr {\n  x\n  }\n"
    reject "Journey"
    reject "journey\n  title a: x"
  }

  ## ------------------------------------------------------------------
  ## xychart (grammars/xy_chart.rb)
  ## ------------------------------------------------------------------

  xychart_integer = 1*DIGIT

  xychart_identifier = ( ALPHA / "_" ) *( ALPHA / DIGIT / "_" )

  xychart_axis_value = *sp ( xychart_integer as value / xychart_identifier as value ) *sp

  xychart_axis_values = "[" xychart_axis_value *( "," xychart_axis_value ) "]"

  xychart_number_value = *sp ( xychart_integer [ "." 1*DIGIT ] ) as value *sp

  xychart_value_array = "[" xychart_number_value *( "," xychart_number_value ) "]"

  xychart_title_line = "title" sp dq_string as title line_end

  xychart_x_axis_line = "x-axis" [ sp dq_string as x_label ] sp xychart_axis_values as x_values line_end

  xychart_y_axis_line = "y-axis" [ sp dq_string as y_label ] sp xychart_integer as y_min sp "-->" sp xychart_integer as y_max line_end

  xychart_line_dataset = "line" sp xychart_value_array as line_values line_end

  xychart_bar_dataset = "bar" sp xychart_value_array as bar_values line_end

  xychart_named_dataset = "dataset" sp dq_string as dataset_label sp xychart_value_array as dataset_values line_end

  xychart_statement = *sp ( xychart_title_line / xychart_x_axis_line / xychart_y_axis_line / xychart_line_dataset / xychart_bar_dataset / xychart_named_dataset / comment newline / *sp newline )

  xychart = "xychart-beta" *sp line_end *xychart_statement as statements

  entry xychart: xychart

  test xychart {
    accept "xychart-beta\n"
    accept "xychart-beta\n  title \"T\"\n  x-axis [a, b]\n  y-axis 0 --> 10\n  line [1, 2.5]\n  bar [3, 4]"
    reject "xychart-beta\n  bogus"
  }
}
